nodes.label: Amadeus GDS Training Simulator
nodes.rationale: Training new travel agents on live production GDS environments carries high financial risks including accidental booking penalties, ADMs, cancellation fees, and query charges; this simulator provides a 100% risk-free simulated environment replicating real terminal behavior.

nodes.label: Dual-Database Support
nodes.rationale: Zero-config SQLite for instant out-of-the-box local development and testing, with PostgreSQL support for production and cloud deployments via an automated SQL parameter abstraction layer.
